title: Death Sound (Bimmalord)
description: Contains a Death Sound for Players.
body:
# Bimmalord's Death Sound

- A lightwight DataPack that contains the **Wither Spawn Sound** the same as _**Unstable SMP**_ the entire server can hear when players dying.

- You can always change the sound in the _death.mcfunction_ file.

- This DataPack they use most on SMP Servers.

Check more projects from me here [Bimmalord Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/user/bimmalord)
